children: Overview
Norway telecom operator's Q3 service revenue grew 1.6% yr/yr to NOK 14.8 bln
Adjusted EBITDA rose 1.5% yr/yr; adjusted EPS up 45% to NOK 2.70
Company expanded Nordic broadband and defence presence with Bahnhof acquisition and KNL defence agreement
Outlook
Telenor reaffirms full-year outlook and longer-term ambitions remain unchanged
Group expects flat to slightly negative organic growth in adjusted EBITDA
Company sees free cash flow before M&A of around NOK 10 bln for 2026
Result Drivers
COST MANAGEMENT - Co said disciplined cost management supported quarter-on-quarter improvement in Norway and maintained profitability in Asia
CUSTOMER GROWTH - Sweden added 35,000 new mobile customers in Q3, marking its 15th consecutive quarter of EBITDA growth
DEFENCE & BROADBAND EXPANSION - Co expanded Nordic defence and broadband presence with KNL defence agreement and Bahnhof acquisition
